headline: Rogue grows real dice
lede: The 1980 cart's level-up law is now the port's: one big kill can lift you several levels at once, a d10 per rung, and healing rolls dice that scale with your hero level.

notes.text: Fetched BSD Rogue 3.6 source and ported check_level verbatim: multi-level jumps (100 XP at level 1 lands level 5), the authentic XP ladder including the original's 40920 misprint, capped at level 20.
Healing potions now roll d4s per level and extra healing d8s per level, with the cart's overflow quirk: a drink on a full bar buys exactly +1 max HP.
The stage's own premise got a source ruling: BSD Rogue has no classes and no int/wis/cha — class gain rolls are Hack/NetHack mythology, now documented so no future lane re-chases it.
roguecheck 192/0 with ten new pins and a proven-dead mutant; roguedrive 29/29 in real Chrome with zero page errors; prod verified by the 40920 marker in the live bundle.
